Title: Honey and Thyme Roasted Carrots
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Main Dish | 500 g | carrots |  | 000069
- Main Dish | 30 g | honey |  | 000363
- Main Dish | 2 tsp | thyme |  | 000250
- Main Dish | 15 g | olive oil |  | 000378
- Main Dish | 1 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Main Dish | 0.5 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Main Dish | Prep | 5 | Preheat your oven to 200 Celsius and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent the honey from sticking.
2. Main Dish | Prep | 5 | Wash and peel the carrots; if they are thick, slice them in half lengthwise to ensure even roasting.
3. Main Dish | Prep | 2 | In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the honey, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and half of the fresh thyme leaves.
4. Main Dish | Prep | 1 | Place the prepared carrots onto the baking sheet and pour the honey-thyme mixture over them.
5. Main Dish | Prep | 1 | Use your hands or a spatula to toss the carrots thoroughly until every piece is generously coated in the glaze.
6. Main Dish | Cook | 30 | Spread the carrots out into a single layer and roast in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, turning them halfway through with tongs.
7. Main Dish | Cook | 2 | Check for tenderness with a fork; the edges should be slightly caramelized and browned when finished.
8. Main Dish | Serve | 2 | Transfer the roasted carrots to a serving platter and garnish with the remaining fresh thyme for a vibrant finish.
